name: Life Changes Astrological Consultation
purpose: For the moments when life is already moving: a new job, a move, a change of direction, or another transition that has you weighing what comes next.
method: I look at current transits to your natal chart with the transition itself as our focus. The goal is to understand which parts of the chart are being activated, what themes are emerging, and how those possibilities connect with the decisions and circumstances already in front of you.
bestFor: A move, career change, or shift in direction already underway or under consideration
Understanding the larger pattern around a transition rather than looking at one decision in isolation
Established clients who are in a season of meaningful change
notFor: A first reading. The Natal Chart Reading comes first so we have a shared foundation
Ongoing month-by-month guidance. That's Monthly Personal Transits
intakeRequirements: The transition you're navigating, via the intake form
includes: How current transits are interacting with your natal chart
Which areas of your life are receiving the most emphasis now
The themes and possibilities surrounding the transition
preparation: Name the change you're navigating and the questions or decisions sitting inside it
